prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1351; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center section, with the left tail lamp assembly broken and the trunk lid skin dented near the latch. Crush and scuff marks on the lower bumper bar line up with the reported rear-end impact, and the damage pattern is consistent with the account given. Nothing I found suggests prior damage to this vehicle, and no earlier repairs are on record. The proposed labor hours are reasonable for replacing the bumper cover and lamp, refinishing the lid, and recalibrating the parking sensors. The supplied invoices show no duplicated charges, so the estimate is supported as written.
